For cross-component project configuration, reconstruct the full ecosystem first. Default new projects use full AHICP + full PPF + Vault Interface. Ordinary private downstream projects prefer workers-builds-native + private-project-quota-saver under the personal ChongLiuPhil account: one short human-assisted GitHub → Cloudflare bootstrap, no GitHub Actions for content-only changes, one thin configuration-PR contract gate, manual heavy GitHub workflows, and Cloudflare Workers Builds as the sole automatic main-branch Web builder. Require a second content-only push to auto-deploy without renewed authorization or a duplicate Actions production build. Public framework repositories retain full CI. Original or unpublished source is private by default; restricted Continuous Web does not authorize private-state retrieval. Provider credential plaintext never belongs in chat/model context or Git. Agent-provisioned external CI and the Trusted Secret Broker remain optional advanced infrastructure. Public release, paid Actions, and other reserved gates still require separate human authorization.

For AHICP repository-internal substantive work, continue to follow AHICP's own START_HERE and manifest onboarding order after ecosystem discovery.

Public delivery migration:
The four public framework sections now use one Cloudflare Worker at https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/. GitHub remains the canonical source. Former GitHub Pages sites have been retired.
Migration guide: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_MIGRATION.md
Migration state: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/templates/cloudflare-public-delivery.yaml
